name: Sliplane Object Storage
line: S3-compatible object storage with bucket-scoped keys and versioning.

free.text: 1GB avg/team; free requests/egress; no idle expiry; bucket deletion waits 24h

cells.metered: €5 per 250 GB block after 1 GB per team

sql.math: Sliplane Object Storage is not a database
Sliplane Object Storage is not a database

files.math: (100 GB − 1 GB) ÷ 250 GB, rounded up, is 1 block, which costs €5. Requests and egress are free. VAT is not included.

jobs.math: Sliplane Object Storage does not run background jobs
